subtype: Approach: connecting the mentee to other people [Action]
passage: I'm Zoya, and I share a desk with Dhruv, so I hear his mentoring calls. On Thursday Maria asked about switching into data journalism, and Dhruv said, 'That's outside what I know, I'd only be guessing.' I noticed he didn't leave it there. He picked up his phone, messaged a friend who works at a news desk, and wrote, 'My mentee Maria is thinking about your line of work. Could you give her twenty minutes?' Then he told Maria the friend's name and said he'd check in after the chat. Maria looked surprised, maybe a little nervous, and copied the name into her notes. A week later Maria mentioned that the friend had also introduced her to a reporter who ran a small open data project.

qa.q: What did Dhruv say when Maria asked about data journalism?
qa.a: Dhruv said, 'That's outside what I know, I'd only be guessing.'

qa.q: What might Maria have been feeling when Dhruv passed on the friend's name?
qa.a: Maria seemed surprised and maybe a little nervous, as Zoya notes, though Maria may also have felt grateful.

qa.q: What could Dhruv add to help Maria use the twenty minutes well?
qa.a: Dhruv could ask Maria to prepare two questions beforehand, so the short chat with the friend is spent on what matters most to her.

qa.q: How might Dhruv's friend at the news desk see the request?
qa.a: The friend probably sees a colleague who trusts them and may be glad to help, since twenty minutes is a modest ask.

grounding: Shows a mentor who, faced with a question outside their area, introduces the mentee to a friend in that field.
